events.summary: Quenvara is on time on 44% of its 48 closed lines (27 late, averaging 3.6 days). It holds 6 open lines, 882 EA, worth 1,098,422.81 USD, none past due and none under a delay notice. Its battery packs were recalled on 18 June over a cell defect, and the records do not show whether it can keep shipping. Quenvara is the only supplier of HR-50110, HR-50210 and HR-50310. HR-50110 goes into the Tern T2 at 1 per robot (182 a month), HR-50210 into the Porter P5 at 2 per robot, and HR-50310 into the Heron H1 at 1 per robot; the monthly need for the last two is not in the data. Priya Nair owns this; the item asks Wang Fang to ship the 6 open lines on open terms and asks for a second source for HR-50110, to act by 5 November 2026 (41 days left).

payload.name: draft_supplier_request

args.subject: Open orders HR-50110, HR-50210, HR-50310: firm promise dates and bridge quantity
args.body:
Dear Wang Fang,

We have six open lines with you and would like a firm promise date on each, confirming that the dates we hold still stand. None is past due today.

HPO-26-00429/20 · Battery pack, 48 V 30 Ah LFP (HR-50110) · 227 EA · promised 28 September
HPO-26-00560/10 · Battery pack, 48 V 30 Ah LFP (HR-50110) · 229 EA · promised 21 October
HPO-26-00560/30 · Battery pack, 48 V 60 Ah LFP (HR-50210) · 92 EA · promised 28 October
HPO-26-00609/10 · Battery pack, 48 V 30 Ah LFP (HR-50110) · 179 EA · promised 19 November
HPO-26-00609/20 · Battery pack, 48 V 60 Ah LFP (HR-50210) · 80 EA · promised 20 November
HPO-26-00710/10 · UPS battery module, 24 V 5 Ah LFP (HR-50310) · 75 EA · promised 30 November

Please also tell us what bridge quantity you can supply for the Battery pack, 48 V 30 Ah LFP (HR-50110), on normal terms and without prepayment, and by when it could ship. Please let us know if anything affects your ability to keep shipping these lines.

Please reply by 5 November.

Best regards,
Priya Nair

actions.subject: Quote QV-Q-2609-17: extension of validity
actions.body:
Dear Wang Fang,

Your quote QV-Q-2609-17 for the battery packs HR-50110 (48 V 30 Ah LFP) and HR-50210 (48 V 60 Ah LFP) lapses on 5 November. We are still reviewing it and need more time.

Could you extend the validity of the quote, at the quoted prices and terms, and tell us the new date it would hold to? This is a request for an extension only; it is not an order and does not commit Halden to any purchase.

Please reply as soon as you can.

On our six open lines (HPO-26-00429/20, HPO-26-00560/10, HPO-26-00560/30, HPO-26-00609/10, HPO-26-00609/20 and HPO-26-00710/10, for Battery pack, 48 V 30 Ah LFP (HR-50110), Battery pack, 48 V 60 Ah LFP (HR-50210) and UPS battery module, 24 V 5 Ah LFP (HR-50310)), please give us a firm promise date for each, and tell us whether the dates we hold still stand. Please also tell us what bridge quantity you can supply for the Battery pack, 48 V 30 Ah LFP (HR-50110), on normal terms and without prepayment, and by when it could ship. Please reply by 29 October.

Best regards,
Priya Nair
Halden Robotics
